idea.intent: Tăng số người dùng hoàn thành checklist chuẩn bị chuyến đi bằng cách thêm nhanh các mục từ cẩm nang
idea.problem: Today customer cannot thêm các mục nằm trong cẩm nang vào trip's checklist easily; work is manual and not measurable.
scopeIn: Core flow: Thêm các mục nằm trong cẩm nang vào trip's checklist

requirements.title: View-only trip members and copying a trip
requirements.description: Trip owners can make an invited member view-only. View-only members see the plan, costs and shared checklists but cannot change them, and can copy the trip to their own account to plan it themselves.
requirements.source: Requested by the Product Owner (Christine) in chat on 2026-11-22

ac.given: I own a trip with an accepted member
ac.when: I open Members & invites and set that member to View only
ac.then: the member is stored in trips.viewerIds and shows as 'View only' in the member list

ac.given: I am a view-only member of a trip
ac.then: I see a view-only banner, and controls to add, edit, reorder, tick or delete plan items, costs and shared checklist items are hidden or disabled

ac.given: I am a view-only member
ac.when: I try to write plan items, costs, shared checklists or trip details (UI or API)
ac.then: Firestore security rules reject the write

ac.given: I am a view-only member
ac.when: I tap 'Copy this trip' and confirm
ac.then: a new trip owned by me is created with the plan, checklists and estimated costs I chose, and I can edit it

ac.given: I am the trip owner
ac.when: anyone tries to make me view-only
ac.then: I keep full edit rights

requirements.title: Estimated vs actual cost comparison
requirements.description: Show estimated and actual costs side by side in one view so members can see the difference per item and spot costs that were not in the original estimate.
requirements.source: Requested by the Product Owner (Christine) in chat on 2026-11-22

ac.given: a trip has estimated costs and actual costs recorded from them
ac.then: a 'Estimated vs actual' card lists each estimate with its estimated amount, actual amount, and the difference marked over / under / on budget, with bars to compare

ac.given: an estimate has no actual cost linked yet
ac.then: it shows 'Not spent yet' and is counted in the 'not spent yet' note, not as a saving

ac.given: some actual costs are not linked to any estimate (or their estimate was deleted)
ac.then: they are listed under 'Not in the estimate' with their total, sorted by date

ac.given: the comparison is shown
ac.then: I see total estimated, total actual including extras, and the overall difference

requirements.title: Reorder costs by drag and drop
requirements.description: Members who can edit a trip can change the order of estimated and actual costs by dragging, and the order is saved for the whole group.
requirements.source: Requested by the Product Owner (Christine) in chat on 2026-11-22

ac.given: I can edit the trip
ac.when: I hold the ⠿ handle of a cost and drag it up or down (mouse or touch), or press ↑ / ↓ on the handle
ac.then: the cost moves to the new position and the new order is saved for everyone

ac.given: costs have never been reordered
ac.then: estimates keep the order they were added and actual costs are sorted by date

ac.given: I am a view-only member
ac.then: no drag handles are shown

requirements.title: Combined cost table: estimate, actual and difference in one table
requirements.description: Replace the separate Estimated and Actual tables with one table where each cost item shows its estimate, actual spend and difference on the same row. Users can add a cost with the estimate, the actual, or both at once, and record the actual later. Unplanned actual costs appear in the same table, marked. Field sets for estimate and actual stay the same.
requirements.source: Requested by the Product Owner (Christine) in chat on 2026-11-22 (refines REQ-002)

ac.given: I can edit a trip
ac.when: I tap 'Add a cost' and fill the estimate and/or the 'Already paid' part
ac.then: one estimate and/or one actual cost is saved; if both, the actual is linked to the estimate

ac.given: a cost item has an estimate only
ac.when: I tap 🧾 on its row and save the actual amount
ac.then: the actual is linked to that item and the row shows estimate, actual and difference

ac.given: an item has one or more actual payments
ac.then: the row shows the total actual, the difference (over in red, under in green) and each payment underneath with date, who paid and who shares it

ac.given: an actual cost is not linked to any estimate
ac.then: it appears as its own row tagged 'Unplanned' with no estimate and a + difference

ac.given: the table has rows
ac.when: I look at the last row
ac.then: I see total estimate, total actual and total difference, plus notes for unplanned and not-yet-spent amounts

ac.given: I am a view-only member
ac.then: I see all values but no add, edit, delete or drag controls

requirements.title: Faster page loading
requirements.description: Pages load too slowly on phones. Load the map only when the Map page is opened, load the English dictionary only for English users, stop loading the profile page at start-up, defer detailed country borders, render long photo grids progressively, and render map pins in the background.
requirements.source: Requested by the Product Owner (Christine) in chat on 2026-11-22 after the performance test

ac.given: I open Trips, Guides, Explore, Memories or About
ac.then: the map code (Leaflet, MapLibre, country borders) is not downloaded

ac.given: my language is Vietnamese
ac.then: the English dictionary is not downloaded; switching to English downloads it first and then switches

ac.given: Explore or Memories has many photos
ac.then: about 24 cards render first and more render as I scroll

ac.given: the mobile Lighthouse test (4G) is run on Trips, Guides, Explore and About
ac.then: Largest Contentful Paint and Total Blocking Time are lower than before (baseline: LCP 6.5–7.1 s, TBT 0.6–1.2 s)

requirements.title: Faster first paint: non-blocking CSS and CSS per page
requirements.description: Pages still felt slow. (C) The main stylesheet no longer blocks the first paint: the boot screen (inline CSS) shows at once while the CSS loads in parallel, and the app renders once it is ready. (D) Styles used by only one area (admin, about, guides, gear, tips, legal, profile, trips, share studio, feedback, map) move into their own CSS files that load with that area's code, so the shared stylesheet is much smaller.
requirements.source: Approved by the Product Owner (Christine) in chat on 2026-11-22 ('hãy làm luôn C và D')

ac.given: I open any page
ac.then: the boot screen paints without waiting for the main CSS file

ac.given: the main CSS has not finished loading
ac.when: the app is about to render
ac.then: it waits for the CSS (max 4s) so I never see an unstyled page

ac.given: I open a page such as Guides or About
ac.then: only the shared CSS plus that page's CSS are downloaded, and the page looks the same as before

requirements.title: Journey shows the itinerary date for visited places
requirements.description: Places ticked as visited from the plan showed the day they were ticked (e.g. 22/11) instead of the day in the itinerary. The Journey now shows, for each stop: the memory's date for check-ins with photos; the plan date for places that are in the plan; otherwise the saved date. It is ordered by that date, newest first. Works for existing data without any migration.
requirements.source: Reported by the Product Owner (Christine) in chat on 2026-11-22

ac.given: a place in the plan for 18/11 was ticked visited on 22/11
ac.then: it shows 18/11

ac.given: a check-in memory dated 17/11
ac.then: it shows 17/11

ac.given: stops with different dates
ac.then: they are ordered by the shown date, newest first

requirements.title: Admin can fix the location of famous places with a Google Maps link
requirements.description: In Admin → Places, the Google Maps link box and latitude/longitude were only shown for places the team added. Famous places (curated list / Wikidata) could not be moved when their pin was wrong. The editor now shows the link box and coordinates for every place; moved coordinates are saved in the place override and the map uses them.
requirements.source: Requested by the Product Owner (Christine) in chat on 2026-11-22

ac.given: I reset the place's edits
ac.then: the original location is used again

requirements.title: Edit the text of a checklist item
requirements.description: Members can change the wording of a checklist item when plans change instead of deleting and re-adding it. Tap ✏️ (or double-click the text), Enter or click away to save, Esc to cancel. Ticks, who-ticked and the item's scope are kept. View-only members cannot edit shared lists. Behind the flag checkEdit.
requirements.source: Requested by the Product Owner (Christine) in chat on 2026-11-22

requirements.title: Journey shows the check-in date the user entered
requirements.description: Check-ins with photos showed the upload day (e.g. 18/11) instead of the check-in date the user entered, because trip stops were saved without a date and were not updated when a check-in was edited. Now: stops save the check-in date; editing a check-in's date, caption or trip replaces my stop in the Journey; and the Journey uses the date of my own check-ins directly, so existing stops show the right date at once.
requirements.source: Reported by the Product Owner (Christine) in chat on 2026-11-22

requirements.title: Admin-corrected coordinates apply everywhere
requirements.description: After REQ-018 an admin could fix a place's coordinates, but only the famous-places list used them. requirements.title: Directions open the Google Maps link the admin attached
requirements.description: When Google Maps receives bare coordinates it labels the destination with the nearest named point (e.g. 'Ramayana Cave' for Batu Caves). tests.title: Owner and editors can edit; viewers cannot
Non-members and signed-out users cannot edit
Switching a member between view-only and edit never affects the owner
Viewer UI: banner shown, edit controls hidden, Copy this trip creates an editable copy
steps: Owner sets member B to View only
Sign in as B and open the trip
Check Plan, Costs, Checklist tabs have no add/edit/delete controls
Tap Copy this trip, confirm, and edit the new trip

tests.title: Each estimate shows planned, actual, difference and status
Unlinked actuals are listed as unplanned; totals include them
sortByOrder: ordered items first, others keep fallback order
Dragging writes only items whose position changed
UI: comparison card renders, drag reorders and persists, no handles for viewers
steps: Enable flags costCompare and costReorder
Open a trip with estimates and actuals
Check the comparison card shows over/under/pending and the unplanned list
Drag an actual cost above another; reload; order is kept
Open as a view-only member: no ⠿ handles

tests.title: Unified table rows: items with linked actuals, extras inline, totals
Unified table follows drag order across items and extras
UI: add cost with estimate+actual, estimate only then 🧾 actual, actual only (unplanned)
steps: Enable flag costTable
Add a cost with both parts: one row shows estimate, actual, difference
Add estimate only, then tap 🧾 and save actual: row updates
Add actual only: row tagged Unplanned
View as view-only member: no controls

tests.title: Selected place is drawn once, outside normal pins and clusters
UI: open a place among many pins — highlighted pin and name label; closing removes it
steps: Enable flag selectedPin
Open a country with many famous places
Tap a place: highlighted pin with label appears
Open another place: highlight moves
Close the panel: highlight disappears

tests.title: Group total and per-person share for group / per person / picked people
UI: pick people in the estimate form, label shows names, actual pre-filled with same people
steps: Enable flag costPickPeople
Add an estimate with Pick people (2 members, per person)
Row shows 'per person · A, B' and total = amount × 2
Tap 🧾: actual form splits between A and B

tests.title: View sorts: manual, date, amount, difference, name
Sorting never loses or duplicates rows
PDF rows follow the on-screen order
Summary difference compares only spent items plus unplanned
UI: drag, ↑ ↓, sort menu, save as group order, PDF single table in on-screen order
steps: Enable costTable, costReorder, costSort
Drag a row and tap ↑ ↓: order sticks after reload
Sort by amount, export PDF: same order, single table
Save as group order: other members see it

tests.title: View access: members or public link; link viewers never edit
Tabs visible to link viewers
UI: turn link on, open signed-out, copy trip after sign-in, turn link off
steps: Enable flag tripPublicView
Owner turns on the view-only link and copies it
Open the link in a private window: Plan + Checklist visible, banner shown, no edit controls
Turn on 'Also show costs': Costs tab appears
Copy this trip: sign in, then an editable copy is created
Turn the link off: the link no longer opens the trip

tests.title: PDF keeps arrow characters (→ ← ↔ ⇒) in titles
steps: Name a cost 'Vé máy bay SGN → SIN'
Export the costs PDF
The arrow is visible in the row title
